author: Zolonheias
quote: It's an actual masterpiece, despite the current wave of nonsense reviewbombing by Zelda/Nintendo manchildren and incels. The world is so packed with things happening every thirty feet you barely move on with the main storyline at times. The graphics are astounding, with the 30 FPS limitation barely having any impact on the experience. The characters are fun and the easter eggs and attention do detail really show.
